decisions.reason: As the flagship combined robot directly embodies the firm's publicly stated automation direction and already carries visible development and market-commitment costs, management would be very reluctant to withdraw it absent clear failure.

Although the automatic de-shuttering robot overlaps with the broader combined solution and therefore faces the highest rationalization risk, prior investment and the ability to frame any weak demand as temporary still favor keeping it for now.
The profile storage robot fits the firm's broad engineered system portfolio, so management is likely to retain it to justify recent investment and preserve a complete automation offering.

Because this 2024 product line was launched with several models and supports the firm's integrated plant-equipment proposition, the firm is likely to continue backing it rather than admit an early retreat.

The production analysis software is close to the core offer and strategically supports future-ready automated precast production, making management inclined to keep it and attribute any slow uptake to an early-market adoption phase.
